question.text: For Cat III AIFs in IFSC, Income Tax Act 1961 imposes:

answer.text: Source-based taxation on non-residents (receive/arising/deemed in India)

explanation.text: The Logic: The Income Tax Act, 1961 imposes source-based taxation on non-residents — income received, arising, or deemed to be received or arising in India is taxable. The Trap: Worldwide taxation, tax-free status, or a 100% rate do not match the source-based framework that applies to non-resident investors in an IFSC Cat III AIF. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XIX-B AIF (Cat III) Distributors workbook, p.328 (with IFSC direct-tax context, exemptions, and DTAA discussion on pp.330-332).
